cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [approved_design] Workspace generation 344 §9.3 defines a five-level capability ladder ending in background engineering requests.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [approved_design] Control Room generation 345 §7 and Mature End State generation 346 §§6 and 13 use overlapping R0–R6 and A0–A6 labels with different meanings, including disagreement over external effect versus break glass.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] Create one canonical semantic action-risk registry with non-ordinal stable IDs; map every product label, capability, approval, actor, test, and audit event to it before implementation.

cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [implemented_not_deployed] Workspace's prototype Work Request moves draft → queued → claimed → in_progress → needs_answer/completed.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [approved_design] The Baseline and Control Room require Captured → Triaged → Ready → Claimed → In progress → Verification → Awaiting release → Released → Confirmed/Closed with explicit side states.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] Make the Baseline/Control Room lifecycle canonical and define the Workspace states as a non-authoritative safe projection with an exact mapping and no client-selected transitions.

cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [approved_design] Mature End State generation 346 §38 and Baseline generation 336 §26 label construction-bearing release, environment, CI, and operational work as Phase 0 actions.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [approved_design] Workspace generation 344 §23 treats Phase 0 as preconstruction planning and Phase 1 as the first construction phase.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] End Phase 0 at G0 and rename construction-bearing P0 items Foundation work packages executed in Phase 1.

cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [approved_design] Baseline generation 336 and Mature End State generation 346 require persistent isolated Staging for trustworthy promotion and acceptance.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [approved_design] Control Room generation 345 §34 leaves Staging as planned and suggests introducing it only when repeated risk justifies it.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] Require persistent isolated Staging as a G1 deliverable; keep it Planned/Unknown until proven and retain Rehearsal as a distinct disposable environment.

cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [approved_design] Workspace generation 344 §§1.4 and 9.6 and Mature End State generation 346 §4 exclude Hermes unless a proven unique need exists.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [proposed_for_council] PROP-007 and PROP-010 describe Hermes as the preferred mature orchestrator and possible default Doc runtime.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] Authorize only the bounded synthetic evaluation; keep the mature role future_evidence_gate and ensure Workspace, Control Room, Doc, authority, and recovery remain operable without Hermes.

cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [approved_design] The canonical tenant amendments describe a future customer as receiving an isolated deployment by default.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [proposed_for_council] PROP-009 introduces more than 150 human seats inside one CARR organization tenant using isolated business workspaces.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] Define deployment/customer tenant, CARR organization, business workspace, seat, and membership as distinct levels: CARR's internal workspaces may share its isolated deployment, while any external customer remains isolated by deployment unless Joe later approves another model.

cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [approved_design] Workspace generation 344 §2.1 requires one accountable owner for every item.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [implemented_not_deployed] workspace/fixtures/market-map.v1.json uses shared owner strings such as 'Joe and Dell' for some records.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] Require one accountable owner identifier and a separate collaborators or participants collection in the Market Map and underlying domain contracts.

cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_a: [proposed_for_council] The reconciliation recommends dispositions for PROP-007 through PROP-010.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.claim_b: [current_verified] Its canonical_amendments_after_approval list contains no ordered amendment entries for PROP-007, PROP-008, PROP-009, or PROP-010.
cross_roadmap_contradictions.recommended_resolution: [proposed_for_council] Add exact doctrine and machine-contract amendments for all four forks before the facilitator presents an integrated recommendation to Joe.

strongest_remaining_objections: [approved_design] Construction should not start while authorization semantics and the canonical Work Request state machine remain split across overlapping contracts; these are load-bearing interfaces, not editorial cleanup.
